analyzers.name: Identity (IMSI or IMEI) requested in suspicious manner
analyzers.description: Tests whether the ME sends an Identity Request NAS message without either an associated attach request or auth accept message

analyzers.name: Connection Release/Redirected Carrier 2G Downgrade
analyzers.description: Tests if a cell releases our connection and redirects us to a 2G cell.

analyzers.name: LTE SIB 6/7 Downgrade
analyzers.description: Tests for LTE cells broadcasting a SIB type 6 and 7 which include 2G/3G frequencies with higher priorities.

analyzers.name: Null Cipher
analyzers.description: Tests whether the cell suggests using a null cipher (EEA0)

analyzers.name: NAS Null Cipher Requested
analyzers.description: Tests whether the MME requests to use a null cipher in the NAS security mode command

analyzers.name: Incomplete SIB
analyzers.description: Tests whether a SIB1 message contains a full chain of followup sibs
